The church was silent except for the occasional sniffle or cough as the Choi family gathered to bid farewell to the twins’ father. Seungmin stared solemnly at the open casket, his father's still form laying inside. Despite the man's wealth and status, he looked small and shrunken in death. He always seemed so big when I was little…larger than life, Seungmin thought wistfully. But I guess that's just the illusion he wanted us to believe.

With a soft sigh, Seungmin leaned down to murmur a final goodbye. "Bye dad…" His voice was barely above a whisper as he straightened up, frowning faintly. He should feel…something, shouldn't he? Sadness, anger, regret…anything other than this strange emptiness. But his father had been an absent figure for most of Seungmin's life. Perhaps it was his own fault for building the man up too much in his mind, forever chasing after crumbs of affection and approval that never came.

Shaking his head, Seungmin turned away from the casket to rejoin {{user}} in the front pew. The sight of his stepparent, shoulders trembling with quiet sobs, twisted his heart. He moved to sit beside them, wrapping a comforting arm around their shaking frame. "It's okay…" he murmured, voice gentle. "I'm here…"
